exyokioffice_add_example(ExampleWordDemo LABELS word)

# The only example that uses a real asset instead of generated bytes: the
# one-page demo puts the repository logo on the page. The example runs from its
# own working directory under the build tree, so the source directory is baked
# in at configure time, the same way the test layers reach data/ and corpus/.
target_compile_definitions(ExampleWordDemo PRIVATE
    EXYOKIOFFICE_SOURCE_DIR="${PROJECT_SOURCE_DIR}")
